title: MiMo: Unlocking the Reasoning Potential of Language Model -- From Pretraining to Posttraining
paper_type_zh: 前沿推理模型报告与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 审计规则验证 RL、代码测试奖励、开放权重与未公开数据/审计链之间的边界
one_line: MiMo reports 25T-token reasoning-oriented pretraining, 500K then 6M distilled SFT instances, and 130K rule-verifiable RL problems, while releasing weights and inference code but not the training data, tests, verifiers, rollouts, or complete training stack.
MiMo 报告 13 万条可规则验证的数学/代码 RL 题、测试难度奖励、重采样与公开 checkpoints；任务记录、验证器细节、奖励标定和审计资产仍未公开。
why: It shows why a frontier data ledger must separate pretraining composition, SFT distillation, RL tasks and rewards, actual open artifacts, and benchmark evidence rather than treating open weights as a reusable data recipe.
inclusion_reason: MiMo is a high-value frontier disclosure because it connects reasoning-oriented pretraining, distilled SFT, rule-verifiable math and code RL, test-difficulty rewards, dynamic sampling, and rollout infrastructure while leaving the underlying data and most replay artifacts unavailable.

title: Problem
问题
html:
MiMo asks how much reasoning capability can be prepared during pretraining and then elicited through posttraining in a 7B model. The technical problem spans three data regimes: a 25T-token pretraining corpus intended to preserve dense reasoning patterns, distilled SFT for response and format alignment, and rule-verifiable mathematics and code problems for RL.

The audit problem is different. The report contains unusually concrete construction and reward descriptions, yet the actual pretraining documents, 500K or 6M SFT records, 130K RL tasks, code tests, verifier outputs, and policy trajectories are not released. Open weights and an inference fork therefore establish model availability, not a reusable training-data package.

For this Card, pretraining composition, SFT/distillation, RL data and feedback, open artifacts, and evaluation results are separate ledgers. A count, reward formula, checkpoint, or benchmark score in one ledger cannot fill unknown fields in another.

MiMo 研究一个 7B 模型中有多少推理能力可以在预训练阶段准备，并在后训练阶段被激发。其技术问题横跨三种数据机制：用于保留高密度推理模式的 25T token 预训练语料、用于回答与格式对齐的蒸馏 SFT，以及用于 RL 的规则可验证数学和代码问题。

审计问题有所不同。报告给出了相当具体的构造与奖励说明，但实际预训练文档、50 万或 600 万条 SFT 记录、13 万条 RL 任务、代码测试、验证器输出和策略轨迹均未公开。开放权重与推理 fork 因此只能证明模型可获得，不能构成可复用的训练数据包。

本卡把预训练组成、SFT/蒸馏、RL 数据与反馈、开放工件以及评测结果作为五本独立账本。某一本账中的数量、奖励公式、检查点或基准分数，不能填补另一本账中的 unknown 字段。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The core idea is to align the whole training lifecycle with reasoning. Pretraining improves extraction of mathematics, code, and forum structure; globally deduplicates webpage dumps; applies small-model domain and quality tags; synthesizes reasoning-rich responses; and changes the mixture over three stages. Mathematics and code rise to 70% in Stage 2, while Stage 3 adds 10% synthetic responses and extends context from 8,192 to 32,768 tokens.

Posttraining has two paths. MiMo-7B-RL-Zero applies RL directly to MiMo-7B-Base. MiMo-7B-RL first applies distilled SFT and then RL. The original SFT set contains about 500K filtered responses; a later MiMo-7B-RL-0530 variant reports 6M SFT instances and progressively raises the RL generation budget to 48K.

The RL object is a full solution to one of 100K mathematics or 30K code problems. Mathematics uses Math-Verify. Code uses an online judge and a test-difficulty reward that can grant partial credit by test group. Modified GRPO, dynamic sampling, and a 10% easy-problem pool determine which verified rollouts contribute updates. Model-based curation precedes these programmatic rewards, so the end-to-end construction contract is mixed.

核心思路是让整个训练生命周期面向推理。预训练改进数学、代码与论坛结构的提取，对网页 dump 做全局去重，用小模型进行领域和质量标注，合成推理密集的回答，并在三个阶段改变数据混合。阶段 2 把数学和代码提高到 70%，阶段 3 加入 10% 合成回答，同时把上下文从 8,192 扩展到 32,768 token。

后训练有两条路径。MiMo-7B-RL-Zero 直接在 MiMo-7B-Base 上做 RL；MiMo-7B-RL 先进行蒸馏 SFT，再做 RL。原始 SFT 集约含 50 万条过滤后回答；后续 MiMo-7B-RL-0530 变体报告使用 600 万条 SFT，并把 RL 生成预算逐步提高到 48K。

RL 数据对象是针对 10 万个数学问题或 3 万个代码问题生成的完整解答。数学使用 Math-Verify；代码使用在线判题环境和可按测试组给予部分分数的测试难度奖励。modified GRPO、动态采样与占 10% 概率的简单题池共同决定哪些已验证 rollout 参与更新。由于程序化奖励之前还有模型筛选，端到端构造契约属于 mixed。

title: Method
方法
html:
Pretraining combines web pages, papers, books, code, and synthetic data. Xiaomi reports specialized HTML and PDF extraction for equations, code blocks, forums, and STEM material. Webpage dumps undergo URL and MinHash deduplication, then small language models assign domain and multidimensional quality tags. Synthetic generation asks unnamed reasoning models to analyze selected STEM material, solve math and code problems, and answer general queries such as creative writing. Stage 1 rebalances all sources except synthetic responses to reasoning-task queries; Stage 2 makes math and code 70%; Stage 3 adds 10% synthetic responses and extends context to 32,768. The final total is about 25T tokens, but per-source counts and exact tagger thresholds are unknown.

The original SFT data mix is about 500K open-source and proprietary distilled samples. It removes queries with 16-gram overlap against evaluation benchmarks, mixed-language responses, and incomplete responses, then caps each query at eight responses. Samples are packed to 32,768 tokens with batch size 128; the rendered report does not expose the exact constant learning rate. A later update reports 6M SFT instances, but no sample or teacher manifest.

RL curation yields 100K math and 30K code problems. Math uses model filtering for proof and multiple-choice items, global n-gram deduplication, benchmark decontamination, advanced-model screening for impossible or wrong-answer items, and 16 MiMo-SFT rollouts per remaining problem; pass rate above 90% removes easy items, about half of the original math pool. Code drops tasks without tests, invalid golden solutions, tasks for which advanced models solve no test in 16 rollouts, and tasks solved perfectly by MiMo-SFT across 16 rollouts.

Math rewards use Math-Verify. For code, multiple models produce solutions used to estimate each test's pass rate and cluster tests by difficulty. The strict reward grants a group's score only after all tests in that group and easier groups pass; the soft reward distributes group score over individual tests. Final reward sums passed-test scores. Identities and rollout counts for test calibration, test snapshots, and the rule for choosing strict versus soft reward are unknown.

Original RL uses modified GRPO with no KL loss, dynamic sampling that oversamples and excludes pass-rate-zero and pass-rate-one prompts from update batches, and Clip-Higher. Reported settings are batch 512, actor mini-batch 32, 16 gradient updates per iteration, learning rate 1e-6, maximum length 32,768, temperature 1.0, and top-p 1.0. An easy pool is sampled with 10% probability. Seamless Rollout Engine runs on verl, Ray, and vLLM with continuous rollout, asynchronous rule evaluation, and FIFO-aware early termination. The later RL-0530 variant instead reports on-policy RL with generation length raised from 32K to 38K to 48K; its complete optimizer settings are unknown.

预训练混合网页、论文、书籍、代码与合成数据。小米报告为公式、代码块、论坛和 STEM 材料定制了 HTML 与 PDF 提取；网页 dump 经过 URL 和 MinHash 去重，随后由小语言模型分配领域标签和多维质量标签。合成阶段让未具名推理模型分析高推理深度 STEM 材料、解答数学和代码问题，并处理创意写作等通用查询。阶段 1 对除“推理任务查询的合成回答”之外的全部来源做再平衡；阶段 2 让数学和代码占 70%；阶段 3 加入 10% 合成回答并把上下文扩展到 32,768。最终总量约 25T token，但各来源数量与标签阈值为 unknown。

原始 SFT 数据约含 50 万条开源与专有蒸馏样本。处理流程移除与评测基准存在 16-gram 重叠的查询、语言混杂回答和不完整回答，并把每个查询的回答数限制为八条。训练把样本打包到 32,768 token，batch size 为 128；渲染后的报告没有显示精确恒定学习率。后续更新报告 600 万条 SFT，但没有样本或教师清单。

RL 策展得到 10 万个数学问题和 3 万个代码问题。数学流程用模型过滤证明题与选择题，做全局 n-gram 去重和基准去污染，用高级模型筛除无法解答或答案错误的问题，再对每个剩余问题运行 16 次 MiMo-SFT rollout；通过率超过 90% 的简单题被删除，约占原始数学池的一半。代码流程删除无测试任务、标准解无法通过全部测试的任务、高级模型在 16 次 rollout 中连一个测试也无法通过的任务，以及 MiMo-SFT 在 16 次 rollout 中全部解对的任务。

数学奖励使用 Math-Verify。代码方面，多个模型先生成解答，据此计算每个测试的通过率并按难度聚类。strict reward 只有在某个难度组及全部更简单组的测试均通过时才授予该组分数；soft reward 把组分数平分到组内测试；最终奖励是通过测试所得分数之和。用于测试标定的模型身份、rollout 数量、测试快照以及 strict/soft 的选择规则均为 unknown。

原始 RL 使用去除 KL loss、加入动态采样和 Clip-Higher 的 modified GRPO。动态采样超额生成，并把通过率为 0 或 1 的提示排除在更新批次之外。报告参数为 batch 512、actor mini-batch 32、每轮 16 次梯度更新、学习率 1e-6、最大长度 32,768、temperature 1.0、top-p 1.0；简单题池以 10% 概率抽取。Seamless Rollout Engine 基于 verl、Ray 和 vLLM，采用连续 rollout、异步规则评估和遵循 FIFO 的提前终止。后续 RL-0530 变体改用 on-policy RL，并把生成长度从 32K 提至 38K、再提至 48K；完整优化器设置为 unknown。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Artifact evidence confirms model release, not data release. XiaomiMiMo publishes MiMo-7B-Base, MiMo-7B-SFT, MiMo-7B-RL-Zero, MiMo-7B-RL, and MiMo-7B-RL-0530 weight pages. The official MiMo repository contains the technical report, registry helper, model links, and deployment guidance. XiaomiMiMo also publishes a vLLM fork on feat_mimo_mtp_stable_073 for MiMo/MTP inference. The checked official surfaces do not link a downloadable pretraining, SFT, RL-task, test, verifier, or rollout dataset, and the project repository does not contain the reported end-to-end training stack.

The report's ablations support several narrower claims. It states that difficulty filtering produces 100K math plus 30K code tasks; that 16-rollout easy filtering removes about half of the original math pool; and that a 10% easy-pool sampling probability improves late-training stability. On a five-step trace using 256 H20 GPUs, the full Seamless Rollout Engine reports 2.29x end-to-end speedup, lower idle time, and lower sample waste than naive dynamic sampling. Those are construction and systems measurements, not released data.

Model comparisons provide behavioral evidence. Table 5 contrasts Base, RL-Zero, SFT, and RL checkpoints, while Table 6 contrasts 500K-SFT and 6M-SFT variants and the later 48K-budget model. The report also observes that Base-to-RL code performance keeps improving between steps 2000 and 2500 while mathematics fluctuates and declines, and that a language-mixing penalty can itself be exploited. These observations expose failure modes, but benchmark changes cannot identify which records were correct, licensed, uncontaminated, or responsible for the gains.

工件证据确认的是模型发布，而不是数据发布。XiaomiMiMo 发布了 MiMo-7B-Base、MiMo-7B-SFT、MiMo-7B-RL-Zero、MiMo-7B-RL 和 MiMo-7B-RL-0530 权重页面。官方 MiMo 仓库包含技术报告、注册辅助脚本、模型链接与部署说明。XiaomiMiMo 还在 feat_mimo_mtp_stable_073 分支发布了用于 MiMo/MTP 推理的 vLLM fork。已检查的官方页面没有链接可下载的预训练、SFT、RL 任务、测试、验证器或 rollout 数据集，项目仓库也不包含报告所述的端到端训练栈。

报告消融支持若干更窄的结论：难度筛选得到 10 万个数学题和 3 万个代码题；16 次 rollout 的简单题筛选删除约一半原始数学池；10% 简单题池采样概率有助于后期训练稳定。在 256 张 H20 GPU 上抽取的五步轨迹中，完整 Seamless Rollout Engine 相对 naive dynamic sampling 报告 2.29 倍端到端加速，并降低空闲时间与样本浪费。这些属于构造和系统测量，不是公开数据。

模型比较提供行为证据。表 5 对比 Base、RL-Zero、SFT 与 RL 检查点，表 6 对比 50 万和 600 万 SFT 变体及后续 48K 预算模型。报告还观察到，Base-to-RL 在第 2000 至 2500 步期间代码表现继续提升，而数学表现波动并下降；语言混合惩罚本身也可能被利用。这些观察揭示失败模式，但基准变化无法说明哪些记录正确、获得许可、无污染或真正造成了提升。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
MiMo's useful contribution is the connection between reasoning-oriented pretraining and verifiable posttraining. The pretraining recipe treats equation/code preservation, reasoning-density tagging, staged mixture changes, synthetic responses, and Multi-Token Prediction as preparation for later exploration. The posttraining recipe then contrasts direct Base-to-RL with distilled-SFT-to-RL rather than presenting RL as independent of the base-policy data history.

At the feedback layer, test-difficulty reward is more specific than all-tests-pass code reward. Pass rates from generated solutions define difficulty groups, and strict or soft partial-credit schemes provide signal on problems that would otherwise be reward-sparse. Dynamic sampling, a retained easy pool, and a rollout engine that overlaps generation and verification make the effective data distribution and infrastructure part of the recipe.

None of the individual ingredients—deduplication, model quality taggers, distillation, GRPO, executable tests, dynamic sampling, or asynchronous evaluation—is new by itself. The distinctive disclosure is their lifecycle composition and the report's discussion of failure cases. It remains a mechanism-level disclosure, not a complete open recipe, because the source rows, teachers, tests, verifier configurations, trajectories, and training implementation are absent.

MiMo 的有用贡献是把面向推理的预训练与可验证后训练连接起来。预训练配方把公式/代码保留、推理密度标注、分阶段混合变化、合成回答和 Multi-Token Prediction 都视为后续探索的准备。后训练又对比直接 Base-to-RL 与蒸馏 SFT-to-RL，而不是把 RL 描述成与基础策略数据历史无关的过程。

在反馈层面，测试难度奖励比“全部测试通过才给分”的代码奖励更具体。模型解答的通过率定义测试难度组，strict 或 soft 的部分给分方案让原本奖励稀疏的难题也能提供信号。动态采样、保留的简单题池，以及让生成与验证重叠执行的 rollout 引擎，使有效数据分布和基础设施都成为配方的一部分。

去重、模型质量标签器、蒸馏、GRPO、可执行测试、动态采样和异步评估均非单独的新技术。独特之处在于这些组件的全生命周期组合，以及报告对失败案例的讨论。由于源记录、教师、测试、验证器配置、轨迹和训练实现均未公开，它仍是机制级披露，而非完整开放配方。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• No official data artifact is linked for the 25T-token pretraining corpus, original 500K SFT set, later 6M SFT set, 100K math problems, 30K code problems, tests, rewards, or policy trajectories.
  • Pretraining source identities, per-source token counts, extraction versions, quality taggers, thresholds, synthetic generators, teacher prompts, yields, and rights are unknown. URL and MinHash deduplication are explicitly scoped to webpage dumps, not proven corpus-wide.
  • SFT is described as open-source plus proprietary distilled data, but teachers, source records, licenses, decoding, rejects, and the relationship between the 500K and 6M versions are unknown.
  • RL sources mix open and proprietary collections. Task names, source revisions, answer corrections, licenses, split, and exact checkpoint-to-task membership are not released.
  • Model filters can misclassify proof, multiple-choice, impossible, incorrect, easy, or hard problems. The report does not publish prompts, model revisions, calibration, or rejected-task audits.
  • Math verification checks the endpoint and can be exploited; the authors report reward exploitation during later Base-to-RL math training. Answer extraction and false-accept rates are not disclosed.
  • Code tests can be incomplete, leaked, environment-sensitive, or weak. Test suites, difficulty groups, compiler/runtime images, timeouts, nondeterminism handling, and false-accept audits are absent.
  • Dynamic sampling changes the effective training distribution by removing pass-rate-zero and pass-rate-one prompts; the easy pool adds a second distribution. Per-step retained prompts and probabilities beyond the reported 10% pool draw are unavailable.
  • The explored language-mixing penalty failed to fully solve language mixing and introduced a new exploitation path. Whether and where that penalty appears in released checkpoints is unclear.
  • The official MiMo repository is not the full training implementation. The verified XiaomiMiMo vLLM fork supports inference; modified GRPO, preprocessing, online judge, reward code, Seamless Rollout Engine, and exact run configurations are not published there.
  • Decontamination is scoped and incompletely auditable: SFT reports 16-gram checks and RL math reports n-gram checks, but benchmark snapshots, normalization, matches, removals, code coverage, and pretraining checks are missing.
  • Repository Apache-2.0 and weight-page MIT labels do not license undisclosed training or evaluation data.
  • Benchmark scores, pass@k, repeated sampling, decoding settings, and systems speedups measure model or infrastructure behavior; they do not prove data quality, provenance, rights, or verifier correctness.

• 官方没有为 25T token 预训练语料、原始 50 万 SFT、后续 600 万 SFT、10 万数学题、3 万代码题、测试、奖励或策略轨迹链接数据工件。
  • 预训练来源身份、各来源 token 数、提取器版本、质量标签器、阈值、合成生成器、教师提示、产率和权利均为 unknown。URL 与 MinHash 去重明确只适用于网页 dump，并未证明覆盖全语料。
  • SFT 被描述为开源与专有蒸馏数据的组合，但教师、源记录、许可、生成设置、被拒样本及 50 万/600 万版本之间的关系为 unknown。
  • RL 来源混合开源与专有集合。任务名称、来源修订、答案修正、许可、划分以及检查点到任务的精确归属没有公开。
  • 模型过滤可能误判证明题、选择题、不可解题、错答案题、简单题或难题；报告没有发布提示、模型修订、校准或被拒任务审计。
  • 数学验证只检查终点，可能被利用；作者报告 Base-to-RL 数学训练后期存在奖励利用。答案抽取和误接收率未披露。
  • 代码测试可能不完整、泄漏、依赖环境或覆盖过弱。测试套件、难度组、编译器/运行时镜像、超时、非确定性处理和误接收审计均缺失。
  • 动态采样移除通过率为 0 和 1 的提示，从而改变有效训练分布；简单题池又增加第二种分布。除已披露的 10% 池抽样概率外，逐步保留提示与概率不可得。
  • 实验中的语言混合惩罚没有完全解决语言混合，还引入新的利用路径；该惩罚是否以及在哪些公开检查点中使用并不明确。
  • 官方 MiMo 仓库不是完整训练实现。已核验的 XiaomiMiMo vLLM fork 支持推理，但 modified GRPO、预处理、在线判题、奖励代码、Seamless Rollout Engine 与精确运行配置未在其中发布。
  • 去污染有明确范围但无法完整审计：SFT 报告 16-gram 检查，RL 数学报告 n-gram 检查，但基准快照、归一化、命中、移除、代码领域覆盖和预训练检查缺失。
  • 仓库的 Apache-2.0 与权重页的 MIT 标签不许可未披露的训练或评测数据。
  • 基准分数、pass@k、重复采样、解码设置和系统加速测量的是模型或基础设施行为，不能证明数据质量、来源、权利或验证器正确性。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
For the Frontier Reports and Data Disclosure Ledger track, MiMo is useful because it exposes detailed mechanisms while withholding most data objects. An auditor can separately score pretraining-source disclosure, synthetic generation, SFT distillation, RL task curation, verifier implementation, rollout records, model weights, inference code, training code, and evaluation. MiMo is strong on stage descriptions, task counts, filtering logic, reward design, RL settings, and released weights; it is weak on record-level artifacts and end-to-end replay.

Data builders can borrow several patterns: preserve equations and code during extraction; retain multidimensional quality tags; report mixture changes by stage; cap repeated responses per query; use explicit benchmark-overlap filters; assess difficulty with repeated rollouts; separate all-or-nothing and partial-credit test rewards; retain some easy items for stability; and account for aborted or zero-gradient rollouts. A stronger release would store every source ID, transformation, teacher revision, verifier output, rejected candidate, difficulty decision, stage membership, and checksum.

RLVR researchers can use the report to distinguish a verifier description from a verifier artifact. Reproduction would require the exact Math-Verify configuration, answer extractor, online judge, sandbox, code tests, test-difficulty calibration, strict/soft reward assignment, rollout groups, dynamic-sampling decisions, and optimizer inputs. The current release supports model study and partial inference reproduction, but not reuse of the underlying training corpus or exact policy training.

对“前沿报告与数据披露账本”轨道而言，MiMo 的价值在于机制披露详细，但多数数据对象仍未公开。审计者可以分别评价预训练来源披露、合成生成、SFT 蒸馏、RL 任务策展、验证器实现、rollout 记录、模型权重、推理代码、训练代码和评测。MiMo 在阶段说明、任务数量、过滤逻辑、奖励设计、RL 参数与开放权重方面较强，在记录级工件和端到端重放方面较弱。

数据构建者可借鉴这些模式：提取时保留公式和代码；保存多维质量标签；按阶段报告混合变化；限制同一查询的重复回答数；明确执行基准重叠过滤；用重复 rollout 评估难度；区分全有或全无奖励与部分测试给分；保留部分简单题维持稳定；统计被中止或零梯度 rollout。更强的发布还应保存每个来源 ID、转换、教师修订、验证器输出、被拒候选、难度决定、阶段归属和校验和。

RLVR 研究者可借此区分“验证器描述”与“验证器工件”。复现需要精确的 Math-Verify 配置、答案抽取器、在线判题器、sandbox、代码测试、测试难度标定、strict/soft 奖励分配、rollout 组、动态采样决定和优化器输入。当前发布支持模型研究与部分推理复现，但不支持复用底层训练语料或精确重放策略训练。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep five ledgers separate: 25T-token pretraining, 500K/6M distilled SFT, 100K-math plus 30K-code RL, open weights/inference code, and benchmark or systems evaluation.
  • The RL reward is programmatic, but data curation also uses model filtering and difficulty assessment; the full construction contract is mixed.
  • Difficulty filtering uses 16 rollouts, original RL uses temperature/top-p 1.0, and easy-pool sampling is 10%; test-calibration rollout counts and RL response-group size remain unknown.
  • Official MiMo-7B weights and a XiaomiMiMo vLLM inference fork are available. Training corpora, task/tests, verifiers, trajectories, and complete training code are not linked by the checked official surfaces.
  • Preserve partial and L4: the report is detailed enough for a Chinese-reviewed disclosure ledger, but not for exact data or training replay.

• 区分五本账：25T token 预训练、50 万/600 万蒸馏 SFT、10 万数学加 3 万代码 RL、开放权重/推理代码，以及基准或系统评测。
  • RL 奖励是程序化的，但数据策展还使用模型过滤和难度评估；完整构造契约属于 mixed。
  • 难度筛选使用 16 次 rollout，原始 RL 的 temperature/top-p 均为 1.0，简单题池采样概率为 10%；测试标定的 rollout 数与 RL 回答组大小仍为 unknown。
  • 官方 MiMo-7B 权重和 XiaomiMiMo vLLM 推理 fork 可获得；已检查官方页面没有链接训练语料、任务/测试、验证器、轨迹或完整训练代码。
  • 保持 partial 与 L4：报告细节足以形成中文复核就绪的披露账本，但不足以精确重放数据或训练。

title: Citation
引用
html:
Official citation provided by XiaomiMiMo:

``bibtex @misc{coreteam2025mimounlockingreasoningpotential, title={MiMo: Unlocking the Reasoning Potential of Language Model -- From Pretraining to Posttraining}, author={LLM-Core-Team Xiaomi}, year={2025}, eprint={2505.07608}, archivePrefix={arXiv}, primaryClass={cs.CL}, url={https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.07608} } ``

Primary artifacts: arXiv report, MiMo project repository, MiMo-7B model collection, MiMo-7B-RL, and XiaomiMiMo vLLM inference fork.

XiaomiMiMo 提供的官方引用如下：

``bibtex @misc{coreteam2025mimounlockingreasoningpotential, title={MiMo: Unlocking the Reasoning Potential of Language Model -- From Pretraining to Posttraining}, author={LLM-Core-Team Xiaomi}, year={2025}, eprint={2505.07608}, archivePrefix={arXiv}, primaryClass={cs.CL}, url={https://arxiv.org/abs/2505.07608} } ``

主要官方工件：arXiv 报告、MiMo 项目仓库、MiMo-7B 模型集合、MiMo-7B-RL，以及 XiaomiMiMo vLLM 推理 fork。

value.html: Pretraining draws from web pages, academic papers, books, programming code, and synthetic data, but no source manifest or mixture-by-source ledger is published. The original SFT stage uses about 500K open-source and proprietary distilled samples; a later MiMo-7B-RL-0530 update reports 6M SFT instances. RL uses 100K mathematics and 30K code problems from open-source and proprietary collections. Exact dataset names, records, source revisions, and rights are mostly unknown.

value_zh.html: 预训练取自网页、学术论文、书籍、程序代码与合成数据，但未发布来源清单或按来源混合物账本。原始 SFT 阶段使用约 500K 条开源与专有蒸馏样本；后来的 MiMo-7B-RL-0530 更新报告 6M 条 SFT 实例。RL 使用来自开源与专有集合的 100K 道数学与 30K 道代码问题。精确数据集名称、记录、来源 revisions 与权利大多未知。

value.html: SFT items contain queries and responses, but their schema is not released. RL items are mathematics or programming problems paired with full generated solutions; mathematics requires an extractable rule-checkable answer, while code requires executable submissions and tests. Prompt, response, test, metadata, and reward schemas remain unknown.

value_zh.html: SFT 条目含查询与回复，但其 schema 未发布。RL 条目是配对完整生成解答的数学或编程问题；数学需要可提取的规则可检查答案，而代码需要可执行提交与测试。提示、回复、测试、元数据与奖励 schema 仍未知。

value.html: Synthetic pretraining responses are generated by unnamed advanced reasoning models. SFT responses are described as distilled, but teacher identities and record-level authorship are unknown. RL trajectories are generated by MiMo policies, including direct RL from MiMo-7B-Base and RL from an SFT checkpoint; rollout records are not released.

value_zh.html: 合成预训练回复由未命名的先进推理模型生成。SFT 回复被描述为蒸馏，但教师身份与记录级作者未知。RL 轨迹由 MiMo 策略生成，包括从 MiMo-7B-Base 直接 RL 以及从 SFT checkpoint 做 RL；rollout 记录未发布。

value.html: Mathematics verification uses Math-Verify. Code verification uses an online judge that executes large numbers of unit tests in parallel, with some problems containing hundreds of tests. The exact sandbox image, language/runtime versions, resource limits, test visibility, failure handling, and judge snapshots are unknown.

value_zh.html: 数学核验使用 Math-Verify。代码核验使用并行执行大量单元测试的在线评测器，部分问题含数百个测试。精确沙箱镜像、语言/运行时版本、资源限制、测试可见性、失败处理与评审快照未知。

value.html: Final RL feedback is programmatic. Mathematics uses Math-Verify correctness. Code uses pass-rate-derived test-difficulty groups and either a strict scheme, which requires all tests at a level and all easier levels, or a soft scheme, which divides group score across tests; total reward sums passed-test scores. No format or length reward is reported for the principal recipe. Model-based filters are used before RL, so construction verification is mixed rather than purely programmatic.

value_zh.html: 最终 RL 反馈是程序性的。数学使用 Math-Verify 正确性。代码使用由通过率派生的测试难度组，以及严格方案（要求某级别及所有更易级别的全部测试）或软方案（将组分数分摊到各测试）；总奖励对通过测试分数求和。主配方未报告格式或长度奖励。RL 前使用基于模型的过滤器，因此构建核验是混合的而非纯程序性。

value.html: A mathematics rollout terminates with an answer that Math-Verify can assess. A code rollout is run against tests and receives the sum of applicable passed-test scores. Exact answer-extraction rules, timeouts, compilation failures, nondeterminism handling, test snapshots, and the criterion used to choose strict versus soft code rewards are unknown.

value_zh.html: 数学 rollout 以 Math-Verify 可评估的答案终止。代码 rollout 对照测试运行并获得适用通过测试分数之和。精确答案提取规则、超时、编译失败、非确定性处理、测试快照，以及选择严格与软代码奖励的标准未知。

value.html: MiMo-7B-Base is a decoder-only Transformer trained from scratch on about 25T tokens with GQA, pre-RMSNorm, SwiGLU, RoPE, and a single Multi-Token Prediction layer. Posttraining produces MiMo-7B-RL-Zero directly from Base and MiMo-7B-RL from MiMo-7B-SFT; MiMo-7B-RL-0530 is a later 6M-SFT and extended-budget variant.

value_zh.html: MiMo-7B-Base 是在约 25T tokens 上从零训练的仅解码器 Transformer，带 GQA、pre-RMSNorm、SwiGLU、RoPE 与单个 Multi-Token Prediction 层。后训练从 Base 直接产生 MiMo-7B-RL-Zero，从 MiMo-7B-SFT 产生 MiMo-7B-RL；MiMo-7B-RL-0530 是后来的 6M-SFT 与扩展预算变体。

value.html: Unnamed advanced reasoning models generate synthetic pretraining responses and participate in difficulty filtering. The original and expanded SFT sets contain distilled data, but teacher models, checkpoints, prompts, decoding settings, and per-record teacher assignments are unknown.

value_zh.html: 未命名的先进推理模型生成合成预训练回复并参与难度过滤。原始与扩展 SFT 集含蒸馏数据，但教师模型、checkpoints、提示、解码设置与逐记录教师分配未知。

value.html: Pretraining synthesis prompts models to analyze selected high-reasoning-depth STEM material, solve mathematics and code problems, and answer general-domain queries including creative writing. SFT distillation generation is undisclosed. During RL, the current MiMo policy produces full responses for group-relative updates.

value_zh.html: 预训练合成提示模型分析所选高推理深度 STEM 材料、求解数学与代码问题，并回答包括创意写作在内的通用域查询。SFT 蒸馏生成未披露。RL 期间，当前 MiMo 策略为组相对更新产生完整回复。

value.html: Pretraining has three mixtures: Stage 1 excludes synthetic responses to reasoning-task queries and rebalances low- and high-value domains; Stage 2 raises mathematics and code to 70 percent; Stage 3 adds 10 percent synthetic responses and extends context. RL dynamic sampling oversamples candidates and removes prompts with pass rate 0 or 1 from gradient batches. A separate easy pool is sampled with 10 percent probability to stabilize later updates.

value_zh.html: 预训练有三种混合物：Stage 1 排除对推理任务查询的合成回复并再平衡低价值与高价值域；Stage 2 将数学与代码提升至 70 percent；Stage 3 加入 10 percent 合成回复并扩展上下文。RL 动态采样过采样候选，并从梯度批次中移除通过率为 0 或 1 的提示。单独的简单池以 10 percent 概率采样以稳定后期更新。

value.html: Difficulty filtering uses 16 MiMo-SFT rollouts per retained math problem and 16 rollouts for code easy filtering; advanced-model code screening also uses 16 rollouts. The number of models and rollouts used to calibrate test difficulty, and the policy-update response-group size, are unknown.

value_zh.html: 难度过滤对每道保留数学问题使用 16 次 MiMo-SFT rollouts，代码简单过滤使用 16 次 rollouts；先进模型代码筛选也使用 16 次 rollouts。用于校准测试难度的模型与 rollouts 数量，以及策略更新的回复组大小未知。

value.html: RL training uses temperature 1.0 and top-p 1.0. Posttraining evaluation uses temperature 0.6 and top-p 0.95 and is a separate protocol. Synthetic pretraining and SFT-distillation decoding settings are unknown.

value_zh.html: RL 训练使用 temperature 1.0 与 top-p 1.0。后训练评测使用 temperature 0.6 与 top-p 0.95，是单独协议。合成预训练与 SFT 蒸馏解码设置未知。

value.html: Web pages undergo URL and MinHash deduplication, followed by small-model domain and multidimensional quality tagging; exact taggers and thresholds are unknown. SFT removes queries with 16-gram overlap against evaluation benchmarks, mixed-language or incomplete responses, and caps responses per query at eight. RL math removes proof and multiple-choice items with a model, globally deduplicates and decontaminates, rejects problems unsolved by advanced models, and removes items with MiMo-SFT pass rate above 90 percent over 16 rollouts, eliminating about half of easy math. Code removes items without tests, invalid golden solutions, items with no test solved by advanced models in 16 rollouts, and items solved perfectly by MiMo-SFT in 16 rollouts.

value_zh.html: 网页经过 URL 与 MinHash 去重，随后由小模型做领域与多维质量标记；精确标记器与阈值未知。SFT 移除与评测基准有 16-gram 重叠的查询、混合语言或不完整回复，并将每个查询的回复上限设为八条。RL 数学用模型移除证明与选择题条目，全局去重与去污染，拒绝先进模型未解出的问题，并移除 16 次 rollouts 中 MiMo-SFT 通过率高于 90 percent 的条目，约消除一半简单数学。代码移除无测试条目、无效标准解答、16 次 rollouts 中先进模型未解出任何测试的条目，以及 16 次 rollouts 中被 MiMo-SFT 完美解出的条目。

value.html: Original SFT and RL training pack or generate up to 32,768 tokens. The later MiMo-7B-RL-0530 on-policy run progressively raises generation length from 32K to 38K and then 48K. Aggregate rollout attempts, generated tokens, rejected outputs, and compute are unknown.

value_zh.html: 原始 SFT 与 RL 训练打包或生成最多 32,768 tokens。后来的 MiMo-7B-RL-0530 on-policy 运行将生成长度从 32K 逐步提高到 38K 再至 48K。汇总 rollout 尝试、生成 tokens、拒绝输出与算力未知。

value.html: Original RL uses modified GRPO without KL loss, dynamic sampling, and Clip-Higher. It reports batch size 512, actor mini-batch 32, 16 gradient updates per iteration, learning rate 1e-6, and 32,768-token maximum length. Seamless Rollout Engine runs on verl, Ray, and vLLM with continuous rollout, asynchronous reward computation, and FIFO-aware early termination. The later RL-0530 update reports on-policy RL, but its complete objective and optimizer settings are unknown.

value_zh.html: 原始 RL 使用无 KL 损失的修改 GRPO、动态采样与 Clip-Higher。报告 batch size 512、actor mini-batch 32、每次迭代 16 次梯度更新、学习率 1e-6 与 32,768-token 最大长度。Seamless Rollout Engine 在 verl、Ray 与 vLLM 上运行，带连续 rollout、异步奖励计算与 FIFO 感知提前终止。后来的 RL-0530 更新报告 on-policy RL，但其完整目标与优化器设置未知。

value.html: Pretraining reports about 25T tokens but not a source-by-source count ledger. The original SFT report gives about 500K samples after filtering; the later RL-0530 update gives 6M instances without releasing them. RL reports exactly 100K mathematics plus 30K code problems. These counts describe different stages and versions and must not be combined into a single downloadable-corpus total.

value_zh.html: 预训练报告约 25T tokens，但无按来源计数账本。原始 SFT 报告给出过滤后约 500K 样本；后来的 RL-0530 更新给出 6M 实例但未发布它们。RL 精确报告 100K 道数学加 30K 道代码问题。这些计数描述不同阶段与版本，不得合并为单一可下载语料总量。

value.html: unknown

value_zh.html: 未知

value.html: SFT removes training queries with 16-gram overlap against evaluation benchmarks. RL mathematics reports global n-gram deduplication and benchmark decontamination; code says it follows similar curation but does not publish a complete match ledger. Pretraining corpus-wide benchmark decontamination, benchmark revisions, normalization, thresholds, matches, and removals are unknown.

value_zh.html: SFT 移除与评测基准有 16-gram 重叠的训练查询。RL 数学报告全局 n-gram 去重与基准去污染；代码称遵循类似策展但未发布完整匹配账本。预训练语料范围基准去污染、基准 revisions、归一化、阈值、匹配与移除未知。

items: The pretraining, SFT, RL problem, test, reward, and rollout datasets are described but not released as official data artifacts.

The MiMo repository is primarily a report, model registry, and deployment surface; the verified XiaomiMiMo vLLM fork is inference code, not the complete pretraining, SFT, RL, verifier, online-judge, or Seamless Rollout Engine implementation.

Model-based quality tagging, proof and multiple-choice filtering, difficulty screening, and test calibration can introduce judge errors; taggers, prompts, model revisions, and calibration are unknown.
Math rule verification can accept an exploitable or malformed path to a correct endpoint; the paper reports reward exploitation during later Base-to-RL training.
Code tests can be incomplete, biased, leaked, or environment-sensitive; test cases, difficulty clusters, runtime images, and false-accept audits are not published.
Dynamic sampling removes pass-rate-zero and pass-rate-one prompts from update batches, changing the effective task distribution; per-step retained distributions are not released.
The language-mixing penalty explored by the authors did not fully solve language mixing and introduced a separate exploitation risk; its relationship to released checkpoints is not fully specified.
The 500K-to-6M SFT expansion and the RL-0530 training change are later-version disclosures without sample manifests, teacher lineage, or a complete configuration crosswalk.
SFT and RL decontamination are described at a high level, but exact benchmark snapshots, matches, and removal lists are unavailable; pretraining decontamination remains unknown.

Evaluation repetition counts, decoding temperature, pass@k curves, model scores, and infrastructure speedups are model or systems evidence, not proof of source rights, data correctness, verifier accuracy, or release completeness.
预训练、SFT、RL 问题、测试、奖励与 rollout 数据集有描述，但未作为官方数据产物发布。
MiMo 仓库主要是报告、模型注册与部署面；已核验的 XiaomiMiMo vLLM fork 是推理代码，而非完整预训练、SFT、RL、验证器、在线评测器或 Seamless Rollout Engine 实现。
基于模型的质量标记、证明与选择题过滤、难度筛选与测试校准可能引入评审错误；标记器、提示、模型 revisions 与校准未知。
数学规则核验可接受通向正确终点的可利用或畸形路径；论文报告后期 Base-to-RL 训练中的奖励利用。
代码测试可能不完整、有偏、泄漏或对环境敏感；测试用例、难度簇、运行时镜像与误接受审计未发布。
动态采样从更新批次中移除通过率为零与通过率为一的提示，从而改变有效任务分布；逐步保留分布未发布。
作者探索的语言混合惩罚并未完全解决语言混合，并引入单独的利用风险；其与已发布 checkpoints 的关系未完全指明。
500K-to-6M SFT 扩展与 RL-0530 训练变更是后来版本的披露，无样本清单、教师谱系或完整配置对照表。
SFT 与 RL 去污染在高层描述，但精确基准快照、匹配与移除列表不可得；预训练去污染仍未知。
评测重复次数、解码 temperature、pass@k 曲线、模型分数与基础设施加速是模型或系统证据，而非来源权利、数据正确性、验证器准确性或发布完整性的证明。

value.html: The MiMo project repository and XiaomiMiMo vLLM fork are Apache-2.0. Official MiMo-7B model pages are labeled MIT. No official dataset artifact or data license is linked for the pretraining corpus, 500K or 6M SFT data, 130K RL problems, code tests, policy rollouts, or evaluation inputs. Code and weight licenses do not establish rights to those data.

value_zh.html: MiMo 项目仓库与 XiaomiMiMo vLLM fork 为 Apache-2.0。官方 MiMo-7B 模型页标为 MIT。预训练语料、500K 或 6M SFT 数据、130K RL 问题、代码测试、策略 rollouts 或评测输入均未链接官方数据集产物或数据许可。代码与权重许可不确立对这些数据的权利。

value.html: Web, paper, book, code, and synthetic sources -> extraction, webpage deduplication, quality tagging, and three-stage pretraining mixture -> MiMo-7B-Base -> open/proprietary distilled SFT with overlap and response filtering -> MiMo-7B-SFT -> 100K math and 30K code problem curation, difficulty filtering, rule verification, dynamic sampling, and modified GRPO -> MiMo-7B-RL. A parallel Base-to-RL path yields MiMo-7B-RL-Zero; expanded 6M SFT and 32K-to-48K on-policy RL yield MiMo-7B-RL-0530. Record-level sources, rejects, checkpoints, and run membership are unavailable.

value_zh.html: 网页、论文、书籍、代码与合成来源 -> 提取、网页去重、质量标记与三阶段预训练混合物 -> MiMo-7B-Base -> 带重叠与回复过滤的开源/专有蒸馏 SFT -> MiMo-7B-SFT -> 100K 数学与 30K 代码问题策展、难度过滤、规则核验、动态采样与修改 GRPO -> MiMo-7B-RL。并行 Base-to-RL 路径产生 MiMo-7B-RL-Zero；扩展 6M SFT 与 32K-to-48K on-policy RL 产生 MiMo-7B-RL-0530。记录级来源、拒绝项、checkpoints 与运行成员资格不可得。

value.html: verified

value_zh.html: 已核验

value.html: high

Official arXiv report, XiaomiMiMo project repository, MiMo-7B Hugging Face collection and weight pages, and the XiaomiMiMo vLLM inference fork were checked on 2026-07-19. Model weights and inference code are real. No official pretraining, SFT, RL-task, verifier, test, or rollout dataset was linked by the checked official surfaces.

value_zh.html: 官方 arXiv 报告、XiaomiMiMo 项目仓库、MiMo-7B Hugging Face collection 与权重页，以及 XiaomiMiMo vLLM 推理 fork 已于 2026-07-19 核验。模型权重与推理代码真实。所核验官方面上未链接官方预训练、SFT、RL 任务、验证器、测试或 rollout 数据集。

value.html: card_writer

value_zh.html: 卡片撰写人

value.html: high

Paper, project repository, five official MiMo-7B weight variants, and XiaomiMiMo inference fork are live. The checked official surfaces do not provide the stated training corpora, task records, test suites, verifier implementation, policy trajectories, or end-to-end training code.

value_zh.html: 论文、项目仓库、五个官方 MiMo-7B 权重变体与 XiaomiMiMo 推理 fork 可用。所核验官方面不提供所述训练语料、任务记录、测试套件、验证器实现、策略轨迹或端到端训练代码。
